skills.trigger: When evaluating serial chest X-rays to assess the impact of a mediastinal mass on adjacent structures and response to intervention.
steps: On the baseline image, identify the side of the mediastinal widening or mass and determine the direction of tracheal deviation (the trachea is typically pushed away from the mass).
On the follow-up image, check for resolution of the mediastinal opacity and reassess the tracheal position relative to the spinous processes.

Correlate the normalization of the tracheal position (return to midline) with the disappearance of the mass to confirm successful resection and relief of mass effect, distinguishing this from persistent deviation or lack of change.
